evals.prompt: audit all the pages on the dashboard and tell me what's wired up correctly and what's broken
evals.expected_output: Discovers all pages, applies the 8-check framework to each, produces a summary table with pass/fail/warn per page, lists specific issues with file references.

assertions.text: Report references at least 6 of the 8 standard checks by name (endpoint, response shape, rendered fields, loading, error, empty state, mock data, query params)
Report covers at least 5 distinct pages (Overview, Signals, Positions, Trades, Risk Gate, Bots, Settings)
Report contains a summary table with at least PASS/FAIL/WARN status columns
Each issue listed includes a specific file path reference (e.g., dashboard/web/...) not just vague descriptions
Report does not simply say everything PASSES without reading the actual code files

evals.prompt: can you check if the signals page is actually pulling real data or if anything is hardcoded
evals.expected_output: Reads signals page, SignalTable, signals backend route, and Signal type. Applies all 8 checks. Correctly identifies useAPI hook call and verifies it hits a real backend endpoint with matching types.

assertions.text: Agent reads the backend signals route (dashboard/api/routes/signals.py) not just the frontend
Agent reads the Signal TypeScript type definition
Report correctly identifies that the signals page uses useAPI hook (not hardcoded data)
Report produces a per-page check table with individual pass/fail/warn per check
Report covers loading state check and correctly identifies whether one exists

evals.prompt: before we ship, do a quick pass on every page to make sure loading states and error states are all in place
evals.expected_output: Covers all pages. Explicitly checks for loading states and error states on each. Distinguishes between the two. Produces structured output showing which pages pass/fail on these two checks.

assertions.text: Report covers at least 5 distinct pages
Report explicitly distinguishes loading state from error state (not combined into one check)
Report applies all 8 checks, not just checks 4 and 5 (user asked about those but skill applies full audit)
If any pages are missing error states, they are flagged as FAIL or WARN
Report is structured (table format) rather than just prose paragraphs
